day_shape: US-Iran fighting resumes: Jordan intercepted 8 Iranian missiles, IRGC claims strike on UAE's Al Minhad base, US hit IRGC launchers on Larak Island, CENTCOM says 83 vessels redirected under blockade; Pezeshkian at SCO Bishkek; Isfahan court sentences 10 protesters to death.

threads.label: US-Iran military exchanges across Gulf
threads.summary: Iran launched missiles and drones at US bases in the region, with Jordan intercepting eight missiles and Iranian state TV claiming a drone strike on the UAE's Al Minhad Air Base. A US official said US forces struck two IRGC launchers on Larak Island; Iran International described a renewed military escalation after diplomacy stalled.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz blockade and minelaying dispute
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces have redirected 83 commercial vessels, disabled three and boarded two enforcing a blockade against Iran, and rejected as false IRGC claims that US strikes on minelaying forces were aggression. Defa Press and IRIB claimed Iranian drones and missiles trapped US air defences in Jordan and inflicted heavy American losses.

threads.label: US pressure track: sanctions and internal warnings
threads.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Reuters the department is likely to unveil weekly new secondary sanctions on Iran, according to the Jerusalem Post. A separate Jerusalem Post report said US armed forces chiefs jointly warned Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth that continuing the Iran war risks weakening capabilities elsewhere.

threads.label: Pezeshkian at SCO summit in Bishkek
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian met India's prime minister and Kyrgyzstan's president on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit, while Foreign Minister Araghchi met Mongolia's foreign minister. Pezeshkian told Modi Iran and India could raise economic cooperation by neutralising sanctions effects; Tasnim separately reported Pezeshkian said Tehran still seeks a negotiated solution with Washington.

threads.label: Khamenei and IRGC messaging on unity and revenge
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted Unity Week and Government Week messages urging Islamic countries to recognise their true enemy and calling for national cohesion. Armed forces spokesman Brigadier Shekarchian, quoted by Defa Press and IRIB, claimed hundreds of American dead and thousands wounded, and vowed revenge for the martyred Imam and Minaab school victims.

threads.label: Iran domestic: executions, protests, economy
threads.summary: A Revolutionary Court in Isfahan sentenced 10 protesters to death and six to prison terms up to 25 years, while Leila Abolhasani, 43, was sentenced to death over January protest accusations; Iran International detailed an IRGC Syria veteran's role in the Shahriar crackdown. Iran International also reported the dollar around 2.1 million rials, a €300 million bank-debt arrest, and 44% saying they would not buy a home in Iran.

threads.label: Market effects and regional deals
threads.summary: IRIB, citing Reuters, said Asian stocks and US futures fell and oil rose on Middle East tensions, and reported European gas prices at their highest since January 2023 with EU storage 64.7% full. IRIB also reported a €3 billion Israel-Greece air-defence contract plus a €26 million Rafael drone-shield supplement.

events.summary_en: Middle East shock hits global markets; oil surges and Asia and America stock markets collapse. China's CSI 300 index fell 0.4 per cent and shares of real estate development companies came under pressure; this occurred following announcement of regulatory changes by Beijing. Brent crude oil price reached 90.51 dollars per barrel with a 2.7 per cent increase.

events.title_en: European gas prices reach highest level since January 2023
events.summary_en: European gas prices reach highest level since January 2023. Natural gas prices in Europe on Monday reached their highest level since January 2023 as new tensions in the Middle East have raised concerns about further disruptions in natural gas exports from the Persian Gulf. According to European Gas Infrastructure data, only 64.7 per cent of European Union gas storage facilities are full, which means storage inventory is lower than historical levels for this time of year and raises concerns about efforts to refill storage before the winter heating season. Brent crude oil price increased 2.7 per cent to 90.51 dollars per barrel.

Dr Ranjbar, rector of Islamic Azad University: Islamic Azad University, before the issuance of the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution in 1387, began teaching sacred defence doctrine courses with notification to all units. From 1387 to date, 290 university units have participated in presenting this course and on average 620 committed professors have been responsible for teaching these concepts. Additionally, to date 47,238 classes have been held and one million 918,113 students have successfully completed this training course.

The Islamic Republic's president and Kyrgyzstan's president met on the sidelines of the summit of member states of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation and Shanghai Plus in Kyrgyzstan and discussed the latest status of bilateral relations and cooperation and ways to strengthen mutual engagement. Masoud Pezeshkian and Sadyr Japarov, in this meeting, whilst reviewing the latest developments and progress of cooperation between Tehran and Bishkek, emphasised the need to benefit from existing capacities to develop and deepen the countries' relations in various fields.

events.title_en: Tunisia drowning in infrastructure crisis
events.summary_en: Tunisia drowning in infrastructure crisis. Four years after the start of the infrastructure crisis, Tunisia still faces drought, blackouts, gas shortages and health system collapse. Summer 2026 is the fourth consecutive summer for Tunisia to be marked by drought, water and electricity cuts and relentless pressure on hospitals. What in 2023 became a headline in world media as an "unprecedented crisis" has now become a chronic and debilitating situation; a situation that is no longer newsworthy, but makes life harder day by day for millions of people.

Defence in the Islamic Republic of Iran is not merely a territorial and military matter, but first and foremost, defence of cultural identity and moral and spiritual values against the evils of enemies and mercenaries.
